conflicts.where: Lesson 3 (How it explains the phenomenon) vs Lesson 8
conflicts.problem: Lesson 3 says learners compared the sphere with the open cylindrical and conical buckets using 'Lesson 8 data'. Those bucket surface areas are not calculated until Lesson 8, so the data cannot exist yet. The overview also has learners revisit whether a spherical bucket would be cheaper than the frustum bucket, which needs the same frustum and cone comparison that Lessons 5, 6 and 8 build later.

conflicts.where: Lesson 7 (Overview vs How it explains the phenomenon)
conflicts.problem: The overview places the trophy stand at a Nairobi secondary school inter-house athletics competition. The explanation places the same trophy stand pedestal at a Nakuru County athletics championship. The location of one context is given two different ways.
